{/* HERO SECTION */}

See Your Food. Track Your Nutrition. Save Every Bite.

SeeFood uses AI to analyze your meals, estimate portion sizes, track nutrition, and suggest recipes using ingredients you already have — helping you eat healthier and reduce food waste effortlessly.

{/* WHY SEEFOOD */}

Why SeeFood?

📸 Snap & Analyze

Take a photo of your meal — our AI estimates calories, nutrients, and portion size instantly.

🥗 Smarter Meal Planning

Get meal suggestions based on food you already own before it expires.

♻️ Reduce Food Waste

Turn unused ingredients into delicious meals and track what you consume.

{/* FEATURES */}

Core Features

AI Nutrition Analysis

Upload food photos and get instant portion size estimates, calories, and nutritional breakdown powered by AI.

Meal Prep Suggestions

Get personalized meal ideas based on ingredients you already own — before they expire.

Meal Tracking

Log meals manually or from our recipe library to keep track of your eating habits.

{/* HOW IT WORKS */}

How It Works

1️⃣ Take a Photo

Snap your meal using Telegram or upload directly in the app.

2️⃣ AI Analyzes Your Food

We estimate portion size, calories, and nutrition instantly.

3️⃣ Plan & Track Meals

Receive meal suggestions and track your daily intake easily.

{/* SOCIAL PROOF */}

Built for Students & Health-Conscious Users

Designed to help busy people eat healthier, track meals easily, and reduce waste.

{/* FINAL CTA */}

Ready to See Your Food Smarter?

Join SeeFood and start tracking your meals today.
